description: A scene of a long Wan video by SVI 2.0 Pro (Stable Video Infinity), the recipe of the author of the Wan weights (his workflow "SVI 2or3 ksampler", Civitai 2079192): the nolightning SVI Consistent Face models, Lightning lightx2v and the SVI Pro LoRA at 1.0, shift 8, per scene 7 steps in three samplers - step 0-1 the high model with the SVI LoRA only at CFG 3 (more motion; CFG 4 flickered red, 2026-11-04), 1-4 high + Lightning, 4-7 low + Lightning (CFG 1). The start image is the anchor (latent frame 0) of EVERY scene, the last latent of the scene before (latentChain) its motion: the colours never go through pixels between the scenes and the face is checked against the photo in each one. Bench 2026-11-04 (test-results/video-quality/p4-svi-cf): no drift of colour or contrast over 20 s, the face 0.68-0.76, ~8 min a scene.

latentChain.note: load: LoadLatent of the latent of the scene before; into: its WanImageToVideoSVIPro (prev_samples, motion_latent_count); save: SaveLatent of the sampled latent for the next scene. Scene 1 has no latent before: the load node and prev_samples go, motion_latent_count 0

video.upscaleNote: upscale + smooth: the author of the weights - 4x-NMKD-Siax, then RIFE x4 (64 fps); task 6 2026-11-05, on by default
video.note: the author: the area of 720x720 (FindPerfectResolution); tailFrames = the overlap: a scene after the first starts with 5 frames of the end of the one before (anchor frame + motion latent) and the join blends them (ImageBatchExtendWithOverlap, linear_blend, as Kijai's SVI Pro example); frames = 5 + fps * seconds, 4n+1

timing: 960x544 81 frames: ~480 s a scene with the models loaded (RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB, 2026-11-04)

image.note: the start image of the job in every scene: the anchor

prompt.note: the scene: its first moment (the state at the end of the scene before), then the motion, timestamped

negativePrompt.default: 色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走
negativePrompt.note: stock Chinese negative; it works only in the first sampler (CFG 3)

seed.note: a seed of its own for every scene (SVI: "very important")
